description: The root document's own static shell allowlist is computed from the effective document, after a profile's per-effect provider override already applied, on both engines: the document literally names 'shell' on 't' with allowed_commands: [printf], but the profile overrides 't' to 'json', so 'printf' is no longer granted to a generated child's own shell step -- without the profile, it would run the same way c772-reflector-plan-runs-a-command-the-document-allows does.
